text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Daring Tact wasn't feeling 
well, 
I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry... 
I'll get plenty of rest and recover 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? 
When did I get back to the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! An Ezo red fox?! 
Why are you in the dorm...?!

text_block_list.name: Ezo Red Fox
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Daring Tact. 
You look pretty worn out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: !!? Th-The fox... just spoke?!

text_block_list.name: Shima Enaga
text_block_list.text: Daring Ta~ct! We're here too~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A shima enaga, and even an Ezo flying 
squirrel? 
Wait, what? How?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wild animals from Hokkaido shouldn't 
be living in a dorm room...!

text_block_list.name: Ezo Red Fox
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, see? You get it. 
There's no way we could ever survive 
in a greenhouse like this—

text_block_list.name: Ezo Flying Squirrel
text_block_list.text:
Which means, this is it! An impossible 
world 
born from Daring Tact's secret wish!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...My secret wish...?

text_block_list.name: Ezo Red Fox
text_block_list.text:
You know you've got one, right? A wish 
you've kept hidden deep down. 
That's what we're here for.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! B-But... 
What about disrupting the ecosystem, or 
infectious diseases...?

text_block_list.name: Shima Enaga
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about any of that 
here~. 
Come on, Daring Tact~!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...*Floof!*

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...*Floof, floof, floof, floof, floof!*

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...! An Ezo red fox's tail! 
I've wanted to pet one to my heart's 
content for so, so long!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This springy fluff... I can't stop 
squeezing it! 
Hehe, it's so fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the Ezo flying squirrel really is as 
fluffy as it looks! 
So cute...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As for the shima enaga, let's just cup it 
in both hands 
and gently roll it around. Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. A dream... Of course... 
Still, it was such a wonderfully fluffy 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having spent time with wild animals in her 
dream, 
Daring Tact seemed to feel much better.
